limits: Exact directEnemy source snowmanB, CEL enSnowmanB(Clone), motion renderer SnowMan_Geo/enSnowmanBase and source renderer 121557 only. The same runtime profile binds four companion custom renderers, but this archive grants canonical route credit only to the selected base renderer.

The ordinary zero-focus attack used the native bluntSmithHammer at its unmodified 10 physical damage and 0.81 per-slot accuracy. It produced native Damaged for 10 HP, from 58 to 48, without the skill-cap or damage fixture. The disposable party maximum-HP fortification remained active for test survival and is not representative hero balance.
The explicit KillSingle fixture reduced HP from 48 to 0 with recorded native 1000 damage and a Death trigger. It is fixture death evidence, not ordinary lethal gameplay.

The source has m_DoRagdoll false and zero rigidbodies. The upper-stack separation and persistent Root_M-weighted base are native snowman_damage and snowman_deathDirect animation, not ragdoll evidence.

All three captures retain the requested 120 frames. The exact base renderer remains active, enabled, reported visible and identity-stable through every retained frame. It stays readable through selected pre-loot death frames, but the loot overlay later limits inspection. This does not establish exact terrain contact, collision, later corpse lifetime, cleanup causality or final disposal.
One guarded native Collect action succeeded and strict Ready succeeded at level 0, room 2, with one button.

Seventeen selected original PNGs were reviewed. Native effects, combat UI, foreground hero overlap, smoke, motion blur and the loot panel limit fine inspection in stated frames; the remaining 343 capture PNGs were preserved by hash but not individually reviewed.

This isolated dungeon trial does not prove every snowman animation, collision, culling boundaries, portrait framing, alternate materials, long-session resource lifetime, inheritance to another snowman source, the four companion renderer topologies or finished-art acceptance.
